name: improve-loom-for-my-repo
description: Use at the END of a session in which loom's code tools were used, when the user asks to improve loom, report what it got wrong, or asks "why did loom miss that". Harvests THIS session's own transcript — where loom answered, where you fell back to grep or whole-file reads, what you couldn't trust — and turns each gap into a reproducible finding the loom maintainers can act on. First sessions count most. NOT for filing bugs about repos loom doesn't index, and NOT for gaps this session did not actually hit.
